period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Half-Yearly 2015 unaudited financial statements (clean digital pdftotext, some scattered character-level corruption in individual cells typical of this bank's PDFs). Plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used. Comparative column (31 Dec 2014) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2014 equity of 26963.95m exactly. total_assets was not directly legible (corrupted cell) and was derived as Total Liabilities + Total Equity (235445.77 + 28086.63 = 263532.40), which also matches the separately-legible 'TOTAL LIABILITIES AND SHAREHOLDERS EQUITY' total. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2015 (this Half-Yearly filing's first of four P&L columns: [Jan-Jun 2015] [Jan-Jun 2014] [Apr-Jun 2015 discrete] [Apr-Jun 2014 discrete]). 'Profit before provision' was garbled in the source text ('...170' fragment survived) and was derived via the identity chain (Total Operating Income 6195.02m minus Total Operating Expenses 2243.68m = 3951.34m), then cross-confirmed because Profit Before Tax (3951.34m minus Total Provision 1511.00m = 2440.34m) matches a partially-legible '2,4?0,343,797' fragment in the source text, and PAT (2440.34m minus Tax 1350.00m = 1090.34m) matches the directly-legible 'Net Profit after taxation' and EPS (0.70) figures exactly. No NAV-per-share line is printed in this early filing; nav_per_share is calculated.
